name: Medeu
label: HIGH ABOVE THE EVERYDAY
alt: Medeu mountain sports complex surrounded by the Ile-Alatau mountains
description: Follow the valley into the mountains for crisp air, forest walks, and the famous high-altitude arena. The rink is under reconstruction; check access before going.
transport: Bus 12 toward Medeu, then explore on foot. Check current stops and closures.
descriptionRu: Горная долина, прогулки и знаменитый высокогорный спортивный комплекс. Каток на реконструкции; перед поездкой уточните доступ.

name: Shymbulak
label: YOUR ALPINE ESCAPE
alt: Alpine landscape at Shymbulak mountain resort
description: Ride above the spruce forests to wide-open mountain views. Snowy slopes in winter give way to alpine walks and terrace lunches in summer.
season: Winter for snow · summer for hiking
transport: Travel to Medeu, then take the gondola. Check lift operations before leaving.
descriptionRu: Поднимитесь над еловыми лесами к горным панорамам. Зимой здесь катаются на лыжах, летом гуляют и отдыхают на террасах.

name: Big Almaty Lake
label: A DIFFERENT SHADE OF BLUE
alt: Turquoise Big Almaty Lake beneath high mountain peaks
description: A remarkable turquoise reservoir framed by the Tian Shan. Enjoy the viewpoints and protect this drinking-water source: no swimming or shoreline access.
transport: Arrange transport to the permitted trailhead, then hike. Vehicle access is restricted; check park rules.
descriptionRu: Бирюзовое водохранилище среди Тянь-Шаня. Это источник питьевой воды: купание и выход к берегу запрещены. Уточните правила доступа.

name: Kok-Tobe
label: THE CITY AT YOUR FEET
alt: View of Almaty from the Kok-Tobe hillside
description: Take the scenic route to a hilltop panorama. Come as the afternoon softens, then watch the city lights spread beneath the mountains.
transport: Cable car from the lower station by Republic Palace; check operating hours.
descriptionRu: Поднимитесь на холм ради панорамы города. Особенно красиво в ясный вечер, когда загораются городские огни.

name: Panfilov Park
label: SLOW DOWN IN THE CITY
alt: The colourful Ascension Cathedral in Almaty's Panfilov Park
description: Tree-lined paths, quiet benches, and the colourful wooden Ascension Cathedral make this a lovely place to begin a walk through old Almaty.
transport: Walk from Zhibek Zholy metro. Dress respectfully when entering the cathedral.
descriptionRu: Тенистые аллеи, скамейки и деревянный Вознесенский собор — приятное начало прогулки по старому Алматы.

name: Green Bazaar
label: A TASTE OF LOCAL LIFE
alt: Market stalls inside Almaty's Green Bazaar
description: Wander between dried fruit, spices, cheeses, and local produce. Bring a little cash, ask before taking photos, and leave room for a taste.
transport: Walk north from Panfilov Park; Zhibek Zholy is the nearest central metro stop.
descriptionRu: Сухофрукты, специи, сыры и местные продукты. Возьмите немного наличных и спрашивайте разрешение перед съёмкой.

name: Charyn Canyon
label: MAKE A DAY OF IT
alt: Red sandstone cliffs in Charyn Canyon's Valley of Castles
description: A landscape of sculpted red cliffs and winding trails. The Valley of Castles makes an unforgettable escape from the city.
transport: Book a day tour or a driver. Allow a full day, bring water, and check road and trail conditions.
descriptionRu: Красные скалы и тропы Долины замков. Выделите целый день, возьмите воду и проверьте погоду и состояние дорог.
